usage: Used for leisure hiking or walking on hills and country trails; very common in Hong Kong daily speech.
Can be used on its own or after verbs like 去 or 鍾意, e.g. to talk about going hiking or liking hiking.
Usually refers to outdoor hill walking rather than formal mountaineering; for very difficult climbing, people may use other words.
A very natural, everyday word in spoken Cantonese; good for beginner vocabulary in hobbies and fitness.
